name: researcher-skills
description: Skills for academic researchers: bibliography formatting across ДСТУ, APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE, and ГОСТ standards.

interface.shortDescription: Bibliography formatting and research workflows for academic work
interface.longDescription: Format reference lists per ДСТУ 8302:2015, APA 7th, MLA 9th, Chicago 17th, IEEE, and ГОСТ standards. Handles books, journal articles, dissertations, conference papers, websites, and legal documents.
defaultPrompt: Format my bibliography in APA style.
